messages:
nora: quick spike from a customer - Console shows >100% quota when using cross-project service keys. filing here so eng-platform sees it.

jin: thanks. any sample request?

nora: posted a minimal repro from staging:

```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-cross-aaaa
         x-redwood-org: org-88
         x-redwood-project: proj-99
```

Console rendered two separate series and summed them.

alex: this looks like the same token_origin + owner tagging we discussed. Console used to prefer owner; a recent query refactor removed that fallback.

maria: we need a clear canonical attribution — owner_attr as enum: project:proj-99, org:org-88, legacy:key:sk-cross-aaaa. keep token_origin for debug only.

sam: agree. ops: pipeline change + console toggle. pipeline emits owner_attr and debug_token_origin. console rollup uses owner_attr.

jin: canary plan: 5% traffic with owner_attr emitted, console default to canonical; token_origin visible only if you expand breakdown. add orange "compat" badge when data mixes pre/post.

nora: also need a compatibility view for invoices so billing doesn't change mid-cycle.

alex: add billing_view=compat behind the billing job for 30 days. tests in billing suite required.

maria: UX to add a help link "Why did my usage change?" and quick copy for CS.

deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-owner-attr canary-1 -> 5% traffic.

observability-bot: alert 'quota-diff' muted until 1705090000 by nora.

jin: I'll open pipeline PR with unit tests and a small attribution mapping for legacy keys. ping @maria @sam for reviews.

sam: i'll update runbook and add reconciliation job: compare canonical vs legacy totals after 72h and surface >0.5% diffs.

nora: thanks team. dropping PR links in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
